**(b) Newsletter opening (107 words)**

We are entering a period in which decisions about advanced AI could shape the safety of millions. Our position is clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. This is not a concern we can set aside for another day or soften into vague language. We must take the danger seriously now, while choices about research, development and deployment are still being made. In this newsletter, we examine what is at stake and why public attention matters. We believe clear-eyed, determined action is essential to prevent a catastrophe and protect people from harm.
